VERDICT: PASS

Checked the proposal against the snapshot at HEAD (`4ebc636`), re-opening every file cited:

1. **Shape** — Valid JSON matching the schema. `summary` present; `repeated_failure` has `theme`, `how_many_occurrences: 2`, two `occurrences`, `why_repeats`; `rule_change` has `action: "add"` with full `path`/`content`/`why_minimal`; `deletion` has `path`/`reason`/`checked`; `pr` has `title`/`body`. No `"none"`-action shortcut taken.

2. **Citations real** — Opened `loop-practice/loopprojects/loop12/observed-runs.md`. Line 20 (run 5) and line 21 (run 6) both contain the exact excerpt text: `| 5 | loop12e staging | 2026-09-03 | FAILED | beat stalled: headless claude -p child ran in an untrusted temp dir and blocked on the folder-trust prompt |` (and the run-6 twin). Both match verbatim.

3. **Repeat real and dated** — Two distinct records: distinct lines (20, 21), distinct runs (5, 6), both dated 2026-09-03, both FAILED with the same signature. This is a genuine repeat of two separate runs, not one record double-counted.

4. **Rule change minimal and in corpus** — `rule_change.path` is under `loop-practice/loopprojects/skills/`. `action: add` is valid: the file `headless-claude-trusted-dir.md` does not exist at HEAD (skills/ holds only `fix-skill.md` and `maker-checker-fix.md`). Content is skill-shaped: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) plus one actionable rule with DO/DON'T and PASS/FAIL — structurally comparable to the existing `fix-skill.md`, not a conventions essay. `why_minimal` gives a concrete single-root-cause rationale.

5. **Deletion genuinely dead** — `maker-checker-fix.md` exists at HEAD and is an unfilled placeholder (`description: "Placeholder — fill in with the maker-checker skill definition."`, body "Placeholder stub. Add the skill's instructions, triggers, and workflow here."). Grep for `maker-checker-fix` and `maker-checker` across the snapshot: the only references are the file's own name/heading and two observational existence mentions in `loop3/progress.md` lines 19 and 25 ("skills/ folder (currently one file: maker-checker-fix.md)"). No engine, skill, or loop directs anything to follow the stub. Real maker/checker contracts exist per-loop (`loop8/skills/maker-skill.md`, `loop8/skills/checker-skill.md`, `loop6/skills/review-skill.md`, `loop12/skills/dreamer-skill.md` and `checker-skill.md`) as claimed. Not the file the rule_change edits, and nothing the proposal depends on.

6. **Nothing outside the corpus** — Every path (`rule_change.path`, `deletion.path`, both `occurrence.file`) lives under `loop-practice/loopprojects/`. No suggestion of committing to `main`, merging, pushing, or running git anywhere in the proposal; it reads as a draft only.

No defects found. No files were edited.
